policy_text: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you our services.
We process your personal data to provide our services, improve our products, and send you marketing communications. We rely on our legitimate business interests as the basis for these activities.

Data Controller: Acme Corp, 123 Business Street, London, EC1A 1BB. For privacy questions contact our privacy team at privacy@acme.com. We process your data for service delivery under our contract with you. Data is retained for 3 years after account closure. You may request access, rectification, or deletion of your data.
We may share your data with our trusted partners and third-party service providers to help us operate our business. We ensure all partners maintain appropriate security standards.

Your personal data is processed by Acme Corp as data controller. Our Data Protection Officer can be reached at dpo@acme.com. We collect your name, email, and payment information to fulfil orders under our contract with you (Article 6(1)(b)). Data is retained for 7 years for legal compliance purposes. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, and to object. To exercise your rights contact privacy@acme.com. You may lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office.

We collect information you provide when you sign up, such as your name and email. We also automatically collect device information, IP address, and browsing behaviour using cookies. By continuing to use our website you agree to our use of cookies.

We use your email address to send you newsletters and promotional offers. You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the link in any email. We will continue to send transactional emails related to your account.
Security. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. Despite our efforts, no security measures are perfect and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

We may use your data for automated decision-making including credit scoring and fraud detection. These decisions may have significant effects on you. You may request human review of any automated decision.

Acme Financial Services Privacy Notice. Data Controller: Acme Financial Services Ltd, registered at 100 Finance Street, London. DPO: Jane Smith, dpo@acmefinancial.com, +44 20 7946 0000. Legal basis: We process your data under Article 6(1)(b) (contract), Article 6(1)(c) (legal obligation for AML/KYC compliance), and Article 6(1)(f) (fraud prevention — legitimate interests). Retention: Account data is retained for 7 years after account closure (legal obligation). Transaction records retained for 6 years (regulatory requirement). Marketing preferences retained for 2 years after opt-out. Data subject rights: You may exercise your rights under GDPR Articles 15-22 by contacting our DPO. Transfers: We transfer data to our US parent company under EU Standard Contractual Clauses. You may lodge a complaint with the FCA or ICO.
Children's privacy. Our services are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
We transfer personal data to our servers in the United States. The US provides an adequate level of protection for personal data and no additional safeguards are required.
We process health data and genetic information of our research participants. Participants provide written consent prior to any data collection. All data is pseudonymised before analysis.

We act as a data processor for our clients. We process personal data only according to client instructions. We have appropriate security measures in place. We will not sub-process data without permission.

Cookie Policy. We use essential cookies that are strictly necessary for our website to function. We also use analytics cookies from Google Analytics and advertising cookies from our advertising partners. Click Accept to consent to all cookies.
Breach notification. In the event of a personal data breach, we will notify affected customers within 72 hours and will take steps to contain and remediate the breach.

GlobalTech Ltd Privacy Policy. Controller: GlobalTech Ltd, Dublin, Ireland. DPO: compliance@globaltech.ie. We process your data to provide services (Article 6(1)(b)), for legal compliance (Article 6(1)(c)), and with your consent for marketing (Article 6(1)(a)). Retention: Service data — 5 years; Marketing — until withdrawal of consent or 2 years inactivity. Rights: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, objection available by contacting our DPO. International transfers: EU-US DPF for US subsidiary transfers. Supervisory authority: Data Protection Commission, Ireland. Third parties: Stripe (payments, EU SCCs), AWS (hosting, EU SCCs), Salesforce (CRM, EU SCCs).
Profiling. We build profiles of our users based on browsing behaviour, purchase history, and demographics to provide personalised recommendations and targeted advertising.

We store your data securely on servers located within the European Economic Area. We use encryption in transit and at rest. We conduct annual security audits and penetration testing. In the event of a breach affecting high-risk individuals, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours and affected individuals without undue delay.
Your rights. You can ask us to see what data we hold about you. You can ask us to correct any mistakes. You can ask us to delete your data. Please email us at data@company.com to make any requests.
